question: Under what condition should the teacher grant the teaching that brings long life?
premises: The recipient must be thoroughly examined
Examination should be done always or carefully
The teacher may then give what brings long life
inference: Only after thorough examination should the teacher give this to a worthy person.
uncertainties: cirajīvitam may refer to long life or a teaching conferring it
plain_english: Having always examined him well, one should give it to him for long life.
